output.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01') - SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01')) / NULLIF(SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), 0), 2) AS revenue_growth_pct FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Compares net revenue of completed orders (excluding shipping) in calendar year 2025 with 2024, and returns the percentage growth rounded to 2 decimals. The fiscal year equals the calendar year. Note that list prices rose 4 percent on 2025-01-01, so part of any growth reflects price rather than volume.
